source_document.title: BATX Battery-cell basket: a model-ready specification for a broad manufactured-cell price index (model handoff, draft 1.0)
source_document.transcription_rule: This file restates the brief's requirements in machine-readable form. Where they differ, the brief governs.

status: Working requirements for the handoff. The allocation and scope are the requester's; the calculation mechanics are a reference proposal. Data access, historical coverage, internal series weights and settlement rules are not launch-approved.
core_instruction: Preserve four understandable market categories. Put detailed capacities, product models, and performance specifications underneath them as controlled observations, not as independently weighted headline markets.

buckets.name: LFP storage
buckets.market_category: LFP prismatic cells for stationary energy storage

buckets.name: LFP EV
buckets.market_category: LFP prismatic cells for electric vehicles

buckets.name: Ternary prismatic EV
buckets.market_category: Nickel-based ternary prismatic cells for electric vehicles

buckets.name: Ternary pouch EV
buckets.market_category: Nickel-based ternary pouch cells for electric vehicles

basket.mix: 70% LFP / 30% nickel-based ternary; 40% storage / 60% vehicle cells
basket.weight_basis: Design allocations, not measured market shares or volatility-optimized weights. Preserve 40/30/20/10 unless the requester approves a new design.

excluded: cylindrical cells (excluded from version 1 until comparable industrial-price coverage is established)

hierarchy_rule: A 280 Ah storage cell and a 314 Ah storage cell can both inform the storage category without receiving permanent weights in the headline basket. Broad categories do not authorize unrestricted substitution: freeze the approved series and their internal weights in a versioned source manifest. One supplier appearing on more websites must not gain more influence.
rejected_design: Do not restore separate headline weights for 174 Ah, 158 Ah, 144 Ah, NMC811 21700 5 Ah, or similarly narrow specifications. Detailed eligibility belongs in the source manifest, not the four-category allocation.

controls.product_identity: Record chemistry family, application, casing, model or assessment code, capacity, voltage, performance class, and condition. Keep an observation in exactly one category.
controls.commercial_basis: Record geography, currency, unit, tax basis, delivery terms, quantity tier, payment terms, and spot-versus-contract pricing basis. Compare like with like.
controls.provenance: Keep the original publisher or seller, the actual assessed market or quoted product, observation date, publication time, capture time, and a retrievable evidence reference.
controls.composition: Normalize each approved series against its own base. Do not average whichever listings are available on a given day. New or replacement series require versioned approval.

collection_basis.starting_scope: China domestic industrial cell pricing in native CNY
collection_basis.commercial_basis_rule: Preserve each source's commercial basis; a delivered price is not automatically equivalent to an ex-works price.
collection_basis.unit_rule: Use CNY per Wh when a valid conversion is possible. For per-cell quotes, use the documented rated energy of the exact cell. Do not guess nominal voltage or capacity. A consistent per-cell series may instead be normalized in its original units.
collection_basis.normalization_note: Converting prices to CNY/Wh or indexing them to 100 does not make different performance classes, delivery terms, or product mixes interchangeable. Published category assessments may change their internal sample; track methodology changes rather than assuming composition is fixed.

calculation.method: fixed-base arithmetic index (proposed reference; production settlement method not yet approved)

definitions.P[c,s,t]: eligible positive price for series s in category c at observation time t
definitions.a[c,s]: precommitted within-category coefficient, nonnegative, sum to 1 per category

calculation.internal_coefficients: unspecified until the eligible panel is selected
calculation.base: At the base date every R and C equals 1, so BATX equals 100. All required series need valid base observations under a common, documented timing rule.
calculation.missing_inputs: Missing inputs must not trigger silent reweighting.
calculation.coefficient_type: Base-period coefficients, not a promise that effective contribution shares stay constant after relative prices move. Do not silently substitute a daily rebalanced return index.
calculation.precision: Preserve decimal precision through calculation and round only at the documented output stage.
calculation.currency: The index measures native-CNY price movements; settlement in USDC does not by itself add an FX return. Any currency-conversion exposure must be separately specified.
calculation.rebasing: Rebase or revise only through an approved new version, with an explicit continuity rule.

acceptance_tests.expected: No index change from its appearance

acceptance_tests_note: Hypothetical test vectors, not observed battery returns.

routing_defaults.status: Proposed defaults, not in the brief: the implementing agent's reading of its controls (2026-10-20), so routing is deterministic. The requester may change any of them.
routing_defaults.statuses: The routing statuses of commodity_submission_spec.v1.json (ELIGIBLE_FOR_CONTRACT, CLASSIFIED_CANDIDATE, DUPLICATE_NO_EXTRA_WEIGHT, NEEDS_METADATA, WRONG_PRODUCT, WRONG_PRICE_BASIS, RESEARCH_ONLY, OUTSIDE_COMMITTED_SERIES, SCOPE_CHANGE, STALE_OR_WRONG_PERIOD). Routing classifies; it never refuses a submission.
routing_defaults.physical_scope: cell is admitted; battery_module, pack, storage_system, cathode_material, lithium_carbonate and retail_bundle are WRONG_PRODUCT.
routing_defaults.chemistry: LFP buckets take LFP; ternary buckets take NCM, NCA, NCMA or nickel_ternary; LMFP, LMO, LCO and sodium_ion are WRONG_PRODUCT; a chemistry that doesn't match its bucket is WRONG_PRODUCT.
routing_defaults.casing_and_application: Must match the bucket (prismatic or pouch; stationary_storage or electric_vehicle); cylindrical is WRONG_PRODUCT (excluded from version 1).
routing_defaults.condition: new_unused only; used, second_life and refurbished are WRONG_PRODUCT; unknown is NEEDS_METADATA.
routing_defaults.evidence_class: published_assessment, or direct_price (a seller's recurring quote of one exact cell, with its model, capacity, voltage, performance class and terms exact).
routing_defaults.price_basis: contract, spot and firm_offer are admitted: the brief records spot versus contract and compares like with like, so a series fixes one and a change is SCOPE_CHANGE. listing and forecast are WRONG_PRICE_BASIS.
routing_defaults.currency: CNY; any other currency is RESEARCH_ONLY (it would add an FX return).
routing_defaults.geography: Exactly CN; any other market, or a blend, is RESEARCH_ONLY; an undisclosed market is NEEDS_METADATA.
routing_defaults.capacity: Fixed (exact) or a documented mix for an assessment; exact for a direct quote. Voltage, performance class, tax basis and delivery terms must be stated, and may be not_disclosed for an assessment.
routing_defaults.duplicates: Two series reporting the same row of the same publisher (or the same page) are one series: the later is DUPLICATE_NO_EXTRA_WEIGHT, so one supplier on more websites gains no influence.
routing_defaults.on_chain_within_bucket_rule: The oracle program settles each bucket on the median of its sources' changes from their openings, in whole bps, not on precommitted coefficients a[c,s]. With one series per bucket the two agree. See batx_feasibility.v1.md.

evidence_and_timing.independence: Attribute evidence to its originating publisher, seller, and ultimate data source where known. Syndicated copies count once. Multiple products from one publisher remain exposed to that publisher's methodology and availability.
evidence_and_timing.freshness: Distinguish the assessment period, publication timestamp, capture timestamp, and oracle processing timestamp. Re-fetching a monthly price daily does not produce fresh daily evidence. Do not interpolate prices to manufacture daily volatility.
evidence_and_timing.missing_or_disputed: Flag the condition and apply only a precommitted carry-forward, fallback, dispute, or settlement-delay rule. Until that rule is approved, do not manufacture a final settlement value or redistribute the missing series' weight.
evidence_and_timing.revisions: Retain original captures and corrected vintages. A historical simulation must use only information available at the simulated time. Published corrections need a documented rule before live contracts exist.
evidence_and_timing.immutability: For each open contract, freeze category weights, eligible sources and series, internal coefficients, base values, timing rules, and fallbacks. Replacement products or new sources belong to a future version unless the contract already contains an explicit transition rule.
evidence_and_timing.source_existence_caveat: Source existence is not proof of economically independent prices, stable methodology, sufficient volatility, or legal permission to redistribute data. Treat each as a separate verification task.

starting_points.title: Li-Ion Battery Industry Chain Prices: Battery Cell & Pack
starting_points.brief_says_verified: All four proposed categories appear separately, quoted in RMB/Wh. The price page states a monthly update cadence.
starting_points.brief_says_not_established: Four series are not four independent publishers. The page does not resolve all product, quantity, delivery, or licensing details needed for settlement.

starting_points.title: Lithium prices continue to fluctuate as average cell and system prices edge up (2026-03-20)
starting_points.brief_says_verified: A dated public report gives separate Chinese LFP storage-cell assessments for 100, 280, and 314 Ah.
starting_points.brief_says_not_established: Those narrower series are not automatically a broad storage benchmark or substitutes for EV prices.

starting_points.title: Fastmarkets to launch China PV module, BESS battery cell prices (2026-06-23)
starting_points.brief_says_verified: A published launch specification defines monthly 314 Ah LFP prismatic cells, ex-works domestic China, in yuan/Wh.
starting_points.brief_says_not_established: The methodology notice alone does not establish unrestricted access, a complete price history, or settlement-use permission.

coverage_note: Storage has more distinct publisher leads in this review. Independent coverage for each vehicle category remains unproven. Do not describe the four-category basket as launch-ready or multi-source until the exact series and permissions are verified.
decisions_required_before_settlement: exact source panel and internal coefficients
data access and use rights for every required source

required_outputs.A_source_manifest: Map each category to exact series, original URLs or provider identifiers, product and commercial definitions, publication cadence, access conditions, data-use status, history coverage, and internal coefficients. Mark unknown fields explicitly.
required_outputs.B_calculator_and_tests: Implement the proposed fixed-base method or explain a clearly labeled alternative. Return category indices, total index, contribution diagnostics, evidence lineage, and missing/stale flags. Pass the synthetic tests.
required_outputs.C_feasibility_assessment: Distinguish an analytical prototype from a settlement-ready system. Test actual common-window data before reporting one- or three-month returns, volatility, correlations, stale-price frequency, or sensitivity to panel composition.
